'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come on in, brother! I've got a new little business venture here, and I'm looking for someone who can help me out. I was recently contacted by someone from across the border. Turns out there's a demand over there for stuff taken out of Tarkov. I don't really get who'd be into that, but money's money. Especially when it comes to luxury goods with a bit of history from the city. Yeah, that's exactly how the guy put it. I've got the manpower and plenty of motivation to make some serious cash. But most importantly, I've got experience faking luxury goods. I'm thinking of setting up a workshop to put together some Louise Pitton accessories. Go collect some useful stuff around Tarkov from this list, and I'll make it worth your while.}}

==Objectives==
* Find 10 [[Golden neck chain]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Golden neck chain|items]]
* Find 5 [[Golden rooster figurine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Golden rooster figurine|items]]
* Find 5 [[Golden 1GPhone smartphone]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Golden 1GPhone smartphone|items]]
* Find 10 [[Simple wallet]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Simple wallet|items]]
* Find 5 [[WZ Wallet]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[WZ Wallet|items]]

==Rewards==
* +30,000 [[EXP]]
* 300,000 Roubles
** 315,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 345,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Loui Peeton deluxe wallet]]
{{quote|You helped me out big time, bro! There's already a queue back home for my goods with a "history". Here, take this, for your help.}}
